Celestron NexStar 6SE

The computerized 6-inch that finds it for you — lighter than the 8SE.

around $1,199

A 6-inch computerized Schmidt-Cassegrain on the classic NexStar fork mount. Same GoTo brain as the 8SE, in a lighter, more portable package that's easier to carry to a dark site.

Why we like it

  • Computerized GoTo finds 40,000+ objects
  • Much lighter than the 8SE — genuinely portable
  • Long f/10 focal length great for planets and the Moon

Keep in mind

  • Less light grasp than the 8SE for deep sky
  • Needs power (battery pack or AC)
  • Batteries drain fast in the cold

Specs

Aperture150 mm (6 in)
Focal length1500 mm (f/10)
MountComputerized alt-azimuth GoTo
Optical designSchmidt-Cassegrain
Weight~9.5 kg (21 lb)
